activities.name: [A Winter Dream Fogged Deep in the Woods] Narrative Event
activities.description: Complete the side mission [A Winter Dream Fogged Deep in the Woods] to acquire [Oroberyl]×600, [Elementary Cognitive Carrier], and other rewards.

activities.name: [Snow Over Deep Woods] Guide Event
activities.description: Complete specified missions in the [Snowy Forest] area of the [Wuling] region to claim [Oroberyl]×1200 and [Mark of Perseverance].

activities.name: [Trial of the Bow] Challenge Event
activities.description: Complete Simulations at [Typhoeus's Archery Range] and event-related Trial Missions during the event to earn rewards including [Oroberyl]×1200, [Advanced Cognitive Carrier], [Mark of Perseverance], and [Advanced Progression Selection Crate I].

activities.name: [AIC Support: Chubby Lung Attacks] AIC Production Event
activities.description: Produce support goods and submit them at the outpost to get [Fruits of Altruism Certs], exchangeable for rewards including [Oroberyl]×1600 and [Portrait: Chubby Lung Attacks]. Goods Exchange open until Oct. 7, 2026 at 04:00 (server time).

activities.name: [Sanity Supply] Limited-Time Event (Round 1)
activities.description: Complete specified missions every day to claim Sanity Supply rewards: [Sanity Usage Permit] and [Emergency Sanity Booster].

activities.name: [Purry Big Feline! RAWR!] Giveaway Event
activities.description: Log into the game and participate in various game modes to claim new 5★ operator [Purrchena], [Purrchena's Token]×5, and new 5★ weapon [Dessert Moment (Sword)]×6.

activities.name: [Echoing Bell of an Old City] Guide Event
activities.description: Complete specified missions in [Suiming] of the [Wuling] region to claim [Oroberyl]×1200 and [Mark of Perseverance].

activities.name: [Season of Illusion] (Echoes of War)
activities.description: New season [Season of Illusion] is available, featuring 3 cycles with 3 stages each. Clear all new stages on Normal difficulty to claim rewards including [Oroberyl]×300.

activities.name: [Ridgeline Flows of Autumn] Limited-Time Sign-In
activities.description: Sign in for 7 days in total to earn rewards including [Oroberyl]×1500, [Portrait: Go Forth and Run], and ["Rolling Chubby Lung" Energy Drink].

activities.name: [Runners' Steeplechase] Fun & Games Event
activities.description: Complete the race with 3★, collect balloons, and reach the corresponding Runner's Milestones to claim rewards such as [Oroberyl]×1200 and [Portrait Frame: Champion Runner].

activities.name: [Sanity Supply] Limited-Time Event (Round 2)
activities.description: Complete specified missions every day to claim Sanity Supply rewards: [Sanity Usage Permit] and [Emergency Sanity Booster].

activities.name: [Monumental Etching: Shadow Marked] Limited-Time Challenge
activities.description: Complete various [Umbral Monument] challenges in the [Marked by Dark Shadows] series to claim rewards including [Oroberyl]×1200 and [Advanced Progression Selection Crate I].
